propositions: Inbound fetcher currently resolves only a single query_project and builds one JQL pair with a single enrichment pass, causing multi-project stores to ingest only one project and silently drop parent/comment/issuelink data for other projects
Inbound-created tickets do not record their source project, leaving bridge_project and repos fields unset

Fan out JQL queries and enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink maps) once per configured project from the projects mapping, merging results into a shared snapshot deduplicated by existing seen_keys
Derive source project from jira_key prefix and stamp bridge_project plus repos fields at the CREATE write site using a new projects_store helper
Per-project query ceiling (_ACLI_CEILING) prevents one busy project from exhausting a shared truncation budget
Unseeded mapping (empty projects set) falls back to single configured project for byte-identical regression behavior
